title: We did not just see Barcelona : We felt it
text: We really liked how the tour guide shared captivating tales about life centuries ago, connecting us to the spirit of the city of Barcelona. The historical spots were impressive and for us, the highlight was exploring the iconic La Boqueria market, full of colors, aromas, and friendly vendors. We did not just see Barcelona : We felt it.
author: annadC6903HZ

title: A must-do for any tourist visiting Barcelona
text: The guide provided the group personalized attention and also helped us to engage with the friendly locals, while discovering Barcelona’s history and culture. We saw important historical landmarks of Barcelona. A must-do for any tourist visiting Barcelona.
author: arnoldf349
